title: mnemonica .tactica collections
description: The types-collection manifest of one .tactica source (format version 1.2). Collection ids are the join key for the `collection_N::` prefixes in fullPaths; see tactica/README.md.

version.description: Format version. Required; only "1.2" is accepted — an older .tactica is regenerated, not read.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

collections.description: One entry per types collection, default (global registry) collection first when present. May be empty when the source has no types at all.

id.description: Minted id (`collection_1`, `collection_2`, ... in first-encounter order). null only for the default (global registry) collection entry. This id is the prefix of that collection's fullPaths.

name.description: Source variable holding the createTypesCollection() result. The default entry carries the synthetic name "defaultTypes".

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based, relative to the project root. null only for the default collection entry (it has no declaration site).

language.description: Source language of this collection's codebase. Required: there is no default language.
